title: Call for efforts to drive sustainable growth in gold-loan sector - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
The first Gold Summit of the Federation of Gold Loan Companies (FGLOC) has called for united efforts by gold-loan companies and other industry stakeholders to ensure sustainable growth, establish common industry standards and strengthen responsible lending practices.

Around 160 representatives of NBFCs and gold-loan firms from across the country participated in the summit held in Kochi.

George Alexander Muthoot, Executive Vice-Chairman of Muthoot Finance, said FGLOC would take the lead in addressing common issues faced by the gold-loan sector. The organisation would expedite efforts to strengthen its role in bringing gold-loan companies together and representing their interests before regulators.

FGLOC currently has 50 gold-loan companies as members and plans to bring more lenders under its umbrella. The organisation will take up common issues concerning the sector with regulators in the collective interest of the industry and work towards the growth of gold-loan companies and the sector, he said.

Pinaki Nath Banerjee, CEO of FGLOC, said the organisation would also work to promote the gold-loan sector. Several large and medium-sized NBFCs have already become members of FGLOC.

The priority now is to expand the federation’s reach by bringing smaller companies and grassroots-level lenders on board, highlighting the benefits of membership and how FGLOC can support their businesses.

Shaji Varghese, CEO of Muthoot FinCorp, said FGLOC would help raise standards in the gold-loan sector. There are immense opportunities in the gold-loan sector.

FGLOC will raise industry standards so that regulators will not have to frequently impose regulations to control the sector. Through this initiative, the organisation will help create an environment conducive to the growth of the sector.

Mayank Sharma, President and Head of Gold Loans at IIFL Finance, highlighted the importance of digital lending platforms in improving gold-loan services.

The FGLOC logo was also unveiled at the summit.
